title: The return map of the cut-open torus as a one-dimensional operator, and its digit recursion
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-09, before the proof attempt. For the cut-open torus walk at n = 2^m, h = n/2, over GF(2): (1) the return map C_s of CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001A equals w^(n+1) T_h(w^-2), T_h(c) the matrix in the ball basis W_k (W_k(t + 1/t) = sum over |j| <= k of t^j, k < h) of F[c][K]/(K^h) of the map f -> (K + c) (iota f)(K + c) mod K^h, iota(W_k) = W_(h-1-k); so lambda != 0 is an eigenvalue of the walk exactly when det(lambda^(n+1) I + T_h(lambda^2)) = 0; (2) T_1 = [c] and T_2h = P [[A(R + c^h), c^h AR], [A + u (c^h u + v)^T, AR + c^h u v^T]] P, A = T_h, R the reversal, u = e_0, v = e_(h-1), P = [[I, R], [0, I]]; (3) S_h = T_h R satisfies det(zI + S_h) = c^h (1 + sum over j < m of (z/c)^(2^j)), so its eigenvalues are c x for the h elements x of GF(n) of trace 1. Target, to be proved or left open with the gap stated: every nonzero root of det(lambda^(n+1) I + T_h(lambda^2)) is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity, at every power of two. (1) to (3) were found by exact computation (1 at sides 4 to 32, 2 for h = 1 to 16, 3 for h = 1 to 32) before this registration; their proofs and the target's are the attempt.
failure_conditions: A power of two at which C_s differs from w^(n+1) T_h(w^-2).
An h at which T_2h differs from P [[A(R + c^h), c^h AR], [A + u (c^h u + v)^T, AR + c^h u v^T]] P.
An h at which det(zI + T_h R) differs from c^h (1 + sum over j < m of (z/c)^(2^j)).
A power of two with a nonzero root of det(lambda^(n+1) I + T_h(lambda^2)) that is not a (2n - 1)-th root of unity (computed false at sides 4 to 128 by CONE-COLLAPSE-20261109-001).
remaining_obligations: the target, the collapse at every power of two
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-09.
validation.status: pre-registered; the statements found by exact computation, the proofs to follow
